name: DBpedia
label: DBpedia
description: DBpedia official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: sparql_query, lookup, spotlight_annotate. Docs: https://www.dbpedia.org/. Public DBpedia endpoints. Courtesy limits. Spotlight annotates third-party text. Distinct hosts; paths are host+path. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One DBpedia request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"sparql_query"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: sparql_query | lookup | spotlight_annotate. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'sparql_query'.

schema.label: confidence
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `confidence` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `format` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: maxResults
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `maxResults` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `query` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `text` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: timeout
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `timeout` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: sparql_query, lookup, spotlight_annotate.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 45. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
